findings.problem: Attributes a stance/motive to Christopher about testimonials and social proof. The corpus records only that no endorsements exist ('None are recorded, so none may be referenced') and that 'describing what he built is grounded; describing how it was received is not' — which is a corpus design rule, not a documented view of Christopher's. His documented reasons for building in public (redefining success, visible beginner, documentation as product, permanence, forcing function) say nothing about declining to rely on reception.
